notes:
Lead profile: early-stage B2B SaaS (in-app assistant for sales reps). Fast, lightweight client; native mobile + web. Team: CTO (Maya Lin), Eng lead (Omar Reyes), Product (Claire Sun).

Primary requirements (voice of customer):
- End-to-end response latency (first token) < 100ms p95 in NA for 1:1 chat flows.
- Streaming with incremental tokens to render UI as typing.
- Predictable per-request cost; cost sensitivity high at scale (10k-50k MAU).
- Want hosted API to start (no infra ops), may look at Dedicated if predictable throughput becomes priority.
- Minimal data retention: transcripts stored 7 days by default, need option for 30/365 for analytics.

Model/preferences & routing:
- Prefer open/opt-out models; want ability to route to smaller quantized model for cheap queries and fall back to full model for long-form answers.
- Interested in Redwood suggestions for batching/kv-cache for session continuity but want low-latency tradeoffs.

POC plan (agreed):
1) Integrate JS streaming SDK (client) into staging web app — 3 days.
2) Run 72-hour traffic test: synthetic sessions + small organic subset (~2k concurrent streaming connections).
3) Measure p50/p95 token latencies, token cost, and error rates; iterate config (batching, model variant).

Sales notes/shorthand:
- "Need that first-token feel like typing — can't have 500ms lag" — CTO Maya.
- Cost sensitivity > feature bells. Will escalate to Dedicated only if hosted can't meet latency & cost targets.
- Ask: provide canned config for mobile streaming + expected billed tokens calc per 1k sessions.

Open questions for SE:
- Which Redwood hosted models demo best-in-class 1st-token latency for short chat turns?
- How does prefix/KV caching work with ephemeral sessions (mobile reconnects)?
- Confirm SSO setup timeline if move to Paid account.

Next steps: SE to provide streaming integration sample, cost projection spreadsheet, baseline p95 latency SLA options. AE to schedule kickoff for 2026-03-15.
